messages:
Maya: Short recap from today's mini DR run. Good overall but uncovered 3 follow-ups: route convergence visibility, restore isolation, and deployment label drift. Logging items below.

Raj: Route convergence showed ~12s tail for some prefixes. I'll add a convergence histogram and a gating check to delay traffic-shift until p95 < 5s. Owner: Raj. Due: 2026-04-07. Ticket: INF-520.

Sofia: Restore was done with shared creds in the sandbox by accident. I'll build an ephemeral-cred restore job and checklist. Owner: Sofia. Due: 2026-03-30. Ticket: INF-521.

Liam: Noted Envoy label drift after canary. Will make healthcheck label required in config schema and add a deploy-time sanity step. Owner: Liam. Due: 2026-04-02. Ticket: INF-522.

dr-bot: mini-dr-2026-04-18: tickets INF-520, INF-521, INF-522 created.

Maya: Add short preflight snippet to runbook: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-backups/prod/ | tail -n3` and `rdb restore --to dr-sandbox --verify --dry-run`. Include explicit "use-ephemeral-creds" note.

Raj: ack; will post Grafana panel JSON.

Sofia: ack; will prototype Jenkins job and attach logs to INF-521.

Liam: ack; I'll open PR for schema change and add a deploy guard.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll update infra/playbooks README and close the loop in INF-520..INF-522. If more items come up, drop here and dr-bot will append.
